SECCA (雪華) evaluates CAD construction agents with a fixed racing-kart reference, isolated FreeCAD MCP execution, canonical white-background renders, and evidence-based judging.

This first release includes the complete source and installable skill, English and Japanese documentation, offline checks, a model-free native CAD smoke test, and published Beam Free trial evidence. Its 25/100 score describes one generated sample. The historical Windows GLM sample is kept separate from controlled Podman comparisons.

Download the ZIP and its SHA-256 file together. The archive contains a `secca/` skill folder with source, frozen assets, documentation, and public experiment records. Dependencies, local runtime volumes, model credentials, and OCI container images are excluded.

Input-image and generated-artifact rights are separate from the MIT code license. Read the bundled `NOTICE.md` before reusing benchmark data. The build recipe does not promise a byte-identical future runtime; preserve and compare immutable image IDs for controlled experiments.
